title: Indoor and outdoor special events: permits, occupant loads and emergency plans
jurisdiction: Alberta (province-wide STANDATA issued by Alberta Municipal Affairs)
code_edition: NBC(AE) 2023 and NFC(AE) 2023 (National Fire Code - 2023 Alberta Edition); printing not stated in document
document_date: Date Issued: January 2025 (platform created January 16, 2025, last updated January 16, 2025)

facts.text: The Discussion says SCOs, owners, facilitators and other ministries asked for guidance on the requirements and enforcement of permits and occupant loads for indoor and outdoor special events.
The process for special events is at the discretion of the municipality in which the event occurs.
The document provides guidance on the minimum safety-code standards needed for an acceptable level of life safety during a special event.
The document notes that other regulatory bodies have minimum standards that must also be met.
